후들거리다.englishDescription: For one's arms or body to tremble repeaptedly, greatly; or to shake one's arms or body repeatedly, greatly.

후원하다.englishDescription: To stand behind another and help him/her.

후환.definitionKo: 어떤 일로 인해 뒷날 생기는 걱정과 근심.
후환.englishDescription: Concerns and anxieties that will develop in the future due to a certain event.

훈기.englishDescription: (figurative) The warm atmosphere created by a kind heart.

훈련소.definitionKo: 훈련을 하기 위해 시설 등을 갖춘 곳. 또는 그런 기관.
훈련소.englishDescription: A place equipped with facilities for training; or such an institution.
훈련소.englishExpression: training camp; training center; training school

훗날.englishDescription: Days coming after a certain time has passed.

휘둘러보다.englishDescription: To look around here and there, repeatedly.

휴학.definitionKo: 일정한 기간 동안 학교를 쉬는 일.
휴학.englishDescription: An act of taking a break from school during a certain period of time.
휴학.englishExpression: leave of absence; time off from school

흐느적이다.definitionKo: 나뭇가지나 천 등의 가늘고 긴 물체가 느리게 흔들리다.
흐느적이다.englishDescription: For a thin, long object such as a twig or cloth, etc., to move back and forth slowly.
For the melody of a song to continue in a draggingly slow and subdued manner.

흐느적이다.definitionKo: 팔다리 등이 힘없이 느리게 움직이다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
흐느적이다.englishDescription: For one's arms or legs, etc., to move feebly, slowly; or to make them move in such a manner.

흘겨보다.definitionKo: 눈동자를 옆으로 굴려 못마땅하게 노려보는 눈으로 보다.
흘겨보다.englishDescription: To look sideways by rolling one's eyes slightly in an expression of disapproval.
